about.metaDes: The story, values and journey of Ho Dien Cong, Fullstack Software Engineer.
about.title: The person behind the code
about.des: A developer who treats every product like a film: clear story, beautiful frames and nothing out of place.
about.story1: I started my professional journey in 2021, building a multi-chain crypto wallet with React Native. Since then I have worked across the whole stack — web, mobile and backend.
about.story2: Most of my work lives in the Web3 world: wallets, NFT platforms and blockchain games used by real people every day. That taught me to care deeply about security, performance and clarity.
about.story3: Outside of work I build my own products end-to-end, from the database to the last animation, because I love seeing an idea become something people can touch.
